verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into his Empower or let a long skirmish run so Relentless Assault stacks; you win if you poke with Q, bait Counter Strike before committing, and all-in once his E and Leap Strike are both down.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided by who controls when extended trades happen, not by raw stats: K'Sante's Q stacks and E shield let him poke and reset safely, but Jax's Counter Strike punishes careless auto-trading and his Empower plus passive attack-speed stacking reward any fight that runs long. Win rate sits at 47.7% over 2267 games, barely above K'Sante's 47.2% baseline, so treat the stated lane edge as real but thin, not a stomp.

theirWindow.when: Jax's E (Counter Strike) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: Do not auto-attack him freely here. If he commits E, he dodges your next basic attacks for its duration then stuns and damages everyone around him when it ends, so trade with Q (Ntofo Strikes) pokes only and hold your own autos until you see him burn it.

yourWindow.when: his E (18-10s cd) and Q (17-5s cd) are both down
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Land Q stacks for the shockwave pull, use E (Footwork) to close or shield through his last swings, and commit W (Path Maker) or R (All Out) for the stun/knockback since he has no dodge or escape to answer with.

start.why: Run in 92.8% of games (48.3% WR, 2504 games) and gives the HP5 and poke damage to win the Q-stack trades before Jax hits his E spike at level 3.

boots.why: 70% pick at 46.6% WR directly cuts the damage from Jax's empowered autos (W) and his passive attack-speed stacking from Relentless Assault; swap to Mercury's Treads (29.5% pick, 53.7% WR) if his Counter Strike stun is deciding fights.

core.why: Spellblade proc and cooldown reduction bring W (Path Maker) down to as low as 10s and add a slow that keeps you on top of Jax between his Leap Strike resets.
Damage reduction scaling with missing health lets you sit in auto range through his Empower pokes without losing the trade war.
This path hits 53.3% WR over 137 games, the best of the three measured builds, and its stacking resistances blunt both his AD and any on-hit/AP itemization he picks up.

runes.keystoneWhy: The proc damage and max-HP growth win the slow-poke war this lane is actually fought with, since Jax has no reliable way to deny you landing an auto every few seconds while you kite with Q.

summoners.why: Run in 81.3% of games at 47.6% WR; Teleport lets you reset after poke exchanges and return to lane or swap sides without giving Jax a free wave, which matters more here than a kill-lane Ignite since neither champion is burst-all-in before level 6.

playing.title: Poke with Q, skip free autos
playing.detail: Use Q (Ntofo Strikes, 3.5s cd, 450 range) to build stacks toward the shockwave pull and farm the trade without extending into auto exchanges where his W (Empower) and passive attack-speed stacking punish you.

playing.title: Bait Counter Strike before committing
playing.detail: Walk into range without autoing until he commits E (Counter Strike); once he whiffs the dodge-and-stun, his defensive tool is gone for 18-10s and you're free to all-in.

playing.title: Hold W for the punish, not the poke
playing.detail: W (Path Maker) charges before it dashes and is on a 14-10s cooldown depending on rank; save the knockback and stun for a committed kill attempt when his E is down, not to close a poke gap.

playing.title: Match ults at level 6
playing.detail: Both ultimates unlock at 6. R (All Out) knocks him through terrain and transforms your kit into bonus damage and healing, so look to use it the moment his E is on cooldown for a clean, low-risk all-in.

playing.title: Build to answer his autos
playing.detail: Iceborn Gauntlet's slow and Thornmail (situational) specifically punish Relentless Assault's attack-speed stacking and his Empower pokes; prioritize the defense that answers auto-attack damage over generic tank stats.

playing.title: Use E to re-enter, not just to shield
playing.detail: E (Footwork) dash plus shield lets you close back in after he over-extends a Leap Strike (700 range); don't hold it purely as a defensive panic button.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, boots, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the trade timing, cooldown reads, and all-in windows are my own tactical judgment layered on top of that data, not measured outcomes.
